name: Forfiles.EXE Child Process Masquerading
description: Detects the execution of "forfiles" from a non-default location, in order to potentially spawn a custom "cmd.exe" from the current working directory.
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.parent.command_line:(*.exe OR *.exe\")) AND process.executable:*\\cmd.exe AND process.command_line:\/c\ echo\ \"*) AND (NOT ((process.parent.executable:(*\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*)) AND process.parent.executable:*\\forfiles.exe AND (process.executable:(*\:\\Windows\\System32\\* OR *\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*)) AND process.executable:*\\cmd.exe))
